summary:
Police in Indian city of Malegaon require identity cards for residents' cattle .
Cows are considered holy and revered by majority Hindu population of Maharashtra state .
Beef traders in the country strongly reacted to the decision and called a month-long strike .
India's Home Minister promises to devise a country-wide law against cow slaughter .

Philadelphia man, 21, with cerebral palsy, left in park for more than four days, police say .
Mother allegedly left him in park with only blanket, Bible, blanket and Bible .
Low temperatures reached mid-30s during the week, and rain was reported in the area Wednesday and Thursday .
The man was transported to Presbyterian Hospital, but CNN affiliates say he's being treated at Children's Hospital .

Nepal has issued 347 permits this year to climb Mount Everest .
The number is a slight increase from the 334 who were given permission last year .
Climbers will take a central route through the Khumbu Icefall, avoiding the area where the April 18, 2014 avalanche killed 16 .

Stephen Hawking has teamed up with Monty Python to create a musical version of "Galaxy Song"
Hawking's version is in honor of Record Store Day, when the 7-inch single will be available for sale .
The song was written by Python member Eric Idle, along with John Du Prez, and is "intricate and informative lecture"

Saudi Arabia's real motives in Yemen likely have nothing to do with protecting the country's "legitimate government"
The kingdom's real motive is to prevent the rise of any popularly supported government in the region that seeks self-determination .
U.S. policy has adopted the Saudi-Gulf narrative on Yemen, effectively placing Saudi ambitions above previous American priorities .
The United States is effectively acting as al Qaeda's air force by bombing the same group that managed to uproot al Qaeda .

Jamal al-Labani, 45, was hit in the back by shrapnel from a mortar shell, family says .
He is believed to be the first U.S. citizen killed in the current violence in Yemen .
More than 200 people have been killed in Aden in the past 11 days .
Yemen has been in political turmoil for months .

Charlotte Dujardin and Valegro win second consecutive Reem Acra FEI World Cup Dressage title in Las Vegas .
Their score of 94.196 narrowly missed their own world record in the sport .
Dutchman Edward Gal and Glock's Undercover were second with 84.696 .
Germany's Jessica von Bredow-Werndl and Unee BB were third with 80.464 .

Documents reveal the bureaucracy of the self-declared Islamic State in Iraq and Syria .
Documents cover vaccination schedules, fishing methods, rent disputes and archaeology .
Education for girls is limited to the age of 15, but they can go to school .
Foosball is played, provided there is no gambling and there are no gambling heads .

Katie Donovan and Dalton Prager met on Facebook and fell in love .
Dalton and Katie were diagnosed with cystic fibrosis and had lung transplants .
Katie was too sick to stay out of the hospital more than six days a week, so she relied on Medicaid .
Doctors predicted Katie wouldn't live a year without new lungs, and Dalton's dad's private insurance wasn't an option .

UltraHaptics creates tactile three-dimensional shapes literally out of thin air, using ultrasound .
The technology could change the way we interact with electronic devices .
They use a small collection of ultrasonic speakers, concentrating the sound waves to a specific point .
Change in air pressure are perceived as suspended tactile surfaces, creating invisible -- but tangible -- interfaces .

Three people taken to hospital following head-on collision between vintage sports car and 4WD .
Crash happened on Easter Sunday night on Warringah Road in Frenchs Forest, northern Sydney .
The 1973 E-Type Jaguar, which is thought to be worth over $120,000 was completely written off .
Nobody was hurt in the collision, however all three adults were taken as a precaution .

Wigan Warriors beat St Helens 12-4 in a pulsating encounter at the DW Stadium .
Dom Manfredi, Louie McCarthy-Scarsbrook and Anthony Gelling both go over for the Warriors .
Joe Burgess scores a try for the visitors 10 minutes from the end to break Saints' resistance .
Wigan climb up to third place in the First Utility Super League table .

Group of eight contracted workers broke into the 52-metre slide after it was closed earlier in the night .
The thrill seekers were travelling at such great speeds that they were unable to stop and broke through the barricade at the bottom of the slide .
A 22-year old woman broke both her legs, a 60-year-old man suffered broken ribs and internal bleeding .
Three contractors escaped without injury .

Brendan Rodgers says he is 'relaxed' about Raheem Sterling's contract situation .
Liverpool boss says club are a 'superpower' of world football and don't have to sell their best players .
Sterling has been offered a new £100,000-a-week contract to stay at Anfield .
The 20-year-old says he's 'flattered' by interest from Arsenal .

Greg Gibbins, 28, was stabbed in the chest outside a pizza store in the early hours of Easter Monday .
Police believe the attack was 'unprovoked' and described him as being 'good citizen who had been behaving himself'
Police have charged a 20-year-old man with murder of the talented football player .
He was refused bail and appeared in Wyong Local Court on Tuesday and remanded in custody .

Golf's first major of the year takes place at Augusta National this week .
World No 1 Rory McIlroy will be aiming to complete a career grand slam .
Has Tiger Woods finally learned to look up and smell the azaleas?
Can Henrik Stenson recover from a bout of flu to beat the flu?

Former US president George H.W. Bush looked in good health as he accompanied Australian tennis player Roy Emerson at the U.S. Men's Clay Court Championship in Houston, Texas .
Bush, 90, fell ill in December and was hospitalized after complaining of shortness of breath .
Both enjoyed watching Kevin Anderson of South Africa battle Jeremy Chardy of France before heavy rains postponed the game .

Dzhokhar Tsarnaev found guilty of all charges in Boston Marathon bombing on Wednesday .
The jury will now decide whether he gets the death penalty or life in prison .
Three people died and 260 were injured in the April 19, 2013 attack in Boston .
Tsarnaev's conviction was widely expected, given his lawyer's startling admission .

Barcelona will offer £50m for Juventus midfielder Paul Pogba, according to Spanish press .
Chelsea are said to be Barca's only realistic transfer rivals for the Frenchman .
Lionel Messi will start for Barca in their return to La Liga against Celta Vigo on Sunday .
Benfica look to wrap up the Primeira Liga title in Portugal with Nicolas Gaitan .

Juventus beat Lazio 2-0 in Turin to move 15 points clear of second place in Serie A .
First-half goals from Carlos Tevez and Leonardo Bonucci seal victory for Juventus .
Lazio's run of six consecutive victories is over and they could drop back to third place .
Sampdoria held to a goalless draw by Cesena to take a share of fourth place .

Aston Villa host Liverpool in the FA Cup semi-final at Wembley on Sunday .
Tim Sherwood has been a fan of Raheem Sterling since he was a 14-year-old at QPR .
The Villa boss is confident his side can cause a shock and reach the final .
Sherwood says he has sympathy for Sterling's recreational activities off the pitch .

Video of Rihanna at Coachella appears to show star preparing a suspicious substance .
The clip, posted on Instagram and quickly deleted, shows star holding white tube in her hands .
After the camera cuts to her friends, it then pans back to Rihanna holding her nose for several seconds .
Speculation rife as to what exactly is going on in the video .

English Bulldog puppy named Hazel tries to get the better of a washing basket .
Hazel leaps onto the basket and forces the basket over onto its base and lands inside it .
Her weight causes the basket to fall onto its side and send her and some clothes onto the floor .
The dog then sits casually next to the basket as if nothing happened before jumping to her feet and taking a bite .

Aaron Cook's application to switch allegiances to Moldova has been approved .
The 24-year-old has refused to fight for Great Britain since May 2012 .
Cook was left out of the 2012 London Olympic squad for the taekwondo .
Moldovan billionaire Igor Iuzefovici funded Cook's citizenship application .
British Olympic chief Bill Sweeney says there was nothing that could have stopped Cook switching .

Wojciech Szczesny will start in goal for Arsenal's FA Cup semi-final against Reading .
The Polish international has lost his place to David Ospina after a number of errors this season .
Ospina has won 11 of 12 Premier League games since the Szczezny chop .
Arsenal boss Arsene Wenger admits he's not backing his No 1 and will prioritise Petr Cech .

Chelsea beat Manchester City 3-1 in the FA Youth Cup final first-leg on Monday .
Chelsea's first-team are currently top of the Premier League table, while City's are fourth .
Tammy Abraham fired Chelsea ahead in the seventh minute with a stunning volley .
City responded through Isaac Buckley's slick low finish inside the box .

Chelsea manager Jose Mourinho stumped by question at press conference .
Mourinho was asked how hard Arsene Wenger pushed him in title race and last season .
Portuguese coach praised the 'top question' before composing himself and giving an equally ambiguous answer .
Chelsea play Arsenal in the Premier League on Sunday .

Tottenham are ready to grant Emmanuel Adebayor a free transfer in the summer .
The Togolese's move to Spurs has proved a massive financial burden for the north London club .
Tottenham would still like to receive a fee for the striker but they just want rid of his massive wages .

Quade Cooper has agreed a two-year deal to join Toulon from the Queensland Reds .
The fly-half becomes the latest Australia international to move abroad .
Cooper will link up with former Wallabies playmaker Matt Giteau .
Toulon are chasing an unprecedented hat-trick of European titles .

Stuart McCall says he is looking at transfer targets for next season .
The interim Ibrox manager still does not know if he will be in charge beyond the current campaign .
Rangers have expanded their scouting network after a haphazard system .
McCall revealed the club's new board are now starting the process of re-establishing their spying network .

Manchester City need eight homegrown players for their first-team squad next season .
Frank Lampard, Scott Sinclair, Micah Richards, Richard Wright and James Milner could all leave .
The Premier League champions are also interested in signing Danny Ings and Jay Rodriguez .
Everton would want at least £50m for Ross Barkley and John Stones .

Stuart McCall has had to get used to Rangers fans booing his own players .
McCall was booed for an error that led to a goal against Raith Rovers .
The Rangers manager hopes that for the time that he is manager of Rangers, McCulloch will be the last player to get booed .
McCall expects the 36-year-old - a strong, experienced footballer - to be fine .

Floyd Mayweather Jnr's personal chef has revealed his weaknesses when it comes to food .
Quiana Jeffries has helped the champ with his strict organic food diet .
She has been cooking for Mayweather since his fight for Manny Pacquiao was announced .
Mayweather's most unhealthy food craving has got to be 'fried hot dogs... with barbecue sauce'
Jeffries has to cope with Mayweather's unconventional timekeeping .

Nancy Perry will no longer teach students at Dublin Middle School and will retire at the end of the year .
Perry is alleged to have told students that Obama is a Muslim and that any parent who support him couldn't be Christian, either .
A 12-year-old boy in Perry's class brought the matter to the attention of his father, Jimmie Scott .
Scott said he immediately requested a parent-teacher conference to which Perry brought along her husband Bill .

Manchester United scouts checked on Porto striker Jackson Martinez last week .
The 28-year-old wants to leave Portugal this summer and his club will listen to offers of around £30m .
Burnley's Danny Ings remains an option, as reported by Sportsmail last month .
Aston Villa's Christian Benteke has been discussed but no approach has yet been made .

Poundland forced to pull decorative plastic Easter Eggs from their shelves over fears children may choke .
Chinese made decorations were 'likely to contravene food imitation safety rules'
The eggs bear a striking similarity to the sugar-coated chocolate treats with a brown 'speckle' designed to make it look like a quail's egg .
They have been withdrawn nationwide ahead of the Easter break .

British national arrested in Turkey after operation against far-left militant group .
He was arrested as part of an operation against the DHKP-C, according to reports .
The group took senior Turkish prosecutor Mehmet Selim Kiraz hostage last week .
Both the prosecutor and the hostage takers were killed after a police shoot-out .
Hekp-C is listed as a terrorist organisation by the US, EU and Turkey .

The prickly Australian mammal was filmed paddling out to sea off Victoria's Mornington Peninsula .
The little echidna was using its ant-eating snout as a snorkel .
Echidnas, like many native Australian animals, are actually 'proficient' swimmers .
They live on a diet of ants, termites, grubs and worms .

Marks and Spencer's first clothes sales rise for four years credited to Belinda Earl .
Married mother-of-two ran Debenhams, Jaeger and Aquascutum .
Sales boosted by celebrity underwear ranges, like those promoted by Rosie Huntington-Whiteley and David Gandy .
M&S also saw a 13 per cent rise in online sales after a year of struggles for its new website .

Theodosia Aresti, 71, moved into a new-build flat in London five years ago .
A blocked pipe unleashed a 'tsunami of sewage' from 239 other flats into her flat .
The pensioner's nightmare began when she noticed a foul smell coming from her bathroom .
Plumber spent four hours trying to stem the tide of sewage .

Lisa Williams, 49, hit taxi driver David Coleman three times with hammer during street fight .
The two families had been 'neighbours at war' since the Colemans moved in next door in 2007 .
Court heard that Williams's sibling Jonathan had smeared mud all over the Coleman's front bay windows .
When the victim went to confront him, they got into a fight and Williams was jailed for 30 months .

Dalny Vostock, a 100-metre long freezer trawler, capsized in the Sea of Okhotsk at 4am local time .
The ship, carrying 132 crew members, tipped over when a fishing net weighing 80 tons was pulled in .
Around 1,300 fishermen and emergency staff are involved in the huge rescue operation .

Prescott City Attorney Jon Paladini says he heard Granite Mountain Hotshot Brendan McDonough heard crew supervisor Eric Marsh and his top deputy arguing over making the dangerous move .
Paladini: Marsh ordered the crew to leave a safe spot where the fire had already burned .
Claim is based on what he says he was told by Darrell Willis, former chief of woodland fires for the city .
McDonough: 'I think you're being misinformed'

Four men have been moved out of intensive care after suspected drug overdoses .
The men collapsed on the vessel on Good Friday, forcing it to dock near the Opera House .
One man is suspected of taking up to four ecstasy pills in one hit .
Police believe at least that man, and possibly the others, had taken 'blue scissor' pills .

Ana Granucci Davis, 28, gave birth to their son Andrew Aaron Lawrence on Tuesday .
Her husband Aaron Davis, 31, was fatally struck by a suspected drunk driver on Saturday .
The driver and his passenger, Rayvorris Altuan Oliver, 27, fled the scene following the crash .
Mitchell faces several charges including DUI manslaughter, vehicular homicide, aggravated fleeing and eluding .

Researchers at UCLA examined the brains of 90 women, 44 of whom took the Pill .
They found the lateral orbitofrontal cortex and the posterior cigulate cortex were thinner in those women taking the contraception .
Synthetic hormones found in the Pill cause these alterations in brain structure and function .
The findings could account for increased anxiety and depressive symptoms .

Christy Mack, 23, left with 18 broken bones, a broken nose, ruptured kidney, a ruptured liver, missing teeth, and a fractured rib .
Mack was in an abusive relationship with MMA fighter Jonathan Paul Koppenhaver, known professionally as War Machine .
He allegedly beat her with a kitchen knife and cut off her mohawk with blunt knife in August 2014 .
Now, nine months later, she has to wear a wig and glasses, and is still undergoing reparative dental work .
She is fighting to see him convicted of attempted murder .

Emma Dickson, 31, developed blood clots in her lungs which moved to her lungs .
Clots caused a condition known as pleural effusion, which led to a collapsed lung .
The clots could have travelled to her brain, causing a stroke .
One month after being discharged from hospital she was finally able to plan her wedding .

Brad Reynolds has become TripAdvisor's most active user with 66,000 contributions in five years .
The American expat critiques every hotel, restaurant and landmark he visits on holiday .
His reviews have been read by millions of travellers around the world .
He has posted reviews from 394 cities and 46 countries, with a map claiming he has travelled more than 600,000 miles .

Nasa has released an infographic explaining which worlds in the solar system have oceans under their surfaces .
Nine other worlds in total are now suspected to have some form of subsurface ocean .
Some may even contain life, according to Nasa .
A Nasa mission next decade will seek to search for water emanating from Europa - and see if it is habitable .

Perfumes can take years off a woman, as long as the smell is subtle .
Vanilla is an aphrodisiac that enhances sensations of pleasure across the central nervous system .
Lavender and citrus smells evoke images of health and cleanliness .
For serious sex appeal you need a slightly heavier scent, one from the perfume group we call the Orientals .

Labour leader says Tory cuts have allowed rapists and violent criminals to go free .
Party's police adviser, Lord Stevens, is being investigated over Stephen Lawrence murder probe .
IPCC will probe claims former Met chief failed to hand over key information to inquiry .
Last year Mark Ellison wrote to Lord Stevens to say he had done nothing wrong .

Daniel Boykin, 33, pleaded guilty to charges of unlawful photography, aggravated burglary, wiretapping, unlawful telephone recording and two computer crimes .
He admitted to repeatedly filming the woman inside a bathroom at Nashville International Airport .
At the time of his arrest last year, Boykin was found with 92 videos of the victim — 29 taken from the airport bathroom — and 1,527 photographs .

Number of Christians in the US will decline from three quarters of the population in 2010 to two thirds in 2050 .
Agnostics and atheists will make up a 'declining share of the world's population' in same time frame .
By 2050, there will be 2.8billion Muslims and 2.9billion Christians, according to Pew Research Center .
The global Buddhist population will remain roughly the same but Hindu and Jewish populations will be larger .

The House In The Sea is located in Newquay and can only be reached by crossing a 90ft-high suspension bridge .
The island is completely surrounded by waves, making for a peaceful retreat .
Although the island is secluded in the ocean, Padstow and Truro are nearby to offer fish and chips or Michelin star dining .

Driver, Sam Smith, begins filming with the tornado just a few hundred yards in front of him .
It then passes right in front, while Mr Smith spoke to his son on the phone .
Storm Prediction Center in Oklahoma: 'Seek shelter in a sturdy building, or underground if possible'

Former US President Bill Clinton says he believes he should take a more backstage role should his wife, Hillary, decide to run for President .
The 68-year-old revealed that becoming a grandparent to his daughter Chelsea's six-month-old daughter Charlotte has tamed the angry side of his personality .
Clinton Foundation is running 3,100 projects around the world, affecting 430 million people .

Jesse Kidder praised for not firing at Michael Wilcox, 27, as he charged at him .
Officer had been warned by dispatchers before he arrived at the scene that the suspect might try 'suicide by cop'
Wilcox, accused of gunning down two people, was also armed . At one point Wilcox said: 'Shoot me or I'll shoot you', but Kidder refuses .
Suspect surrendered and lay on ground with hands outstretched as backup arrived .

Shinjiro Kumagai is a clergyman at a Buddhist temple in Kitakyushu, southwest Japan .
He dresses up as Japanese sci-fi TV hero Kamen Rider 1 and takes to the streets to lay down the law .
Kumagai has the full support of police and even dons an armband certifying him as an official drink-drive patrolman .
The popularity of the show means locals have welcomed the helmeted protector with open arms .

Three reportedly inexperienced abalone divers died after jumping into rough seas off the coast of northern California on Sunday .
The men were part of a group of five divers from the East Coast and San Francisco .
An off-duty firefighter who happened to be fishing nearby spotted the men and called for help .
Abalone is a prized delicacy that sells for up to $70 per pound .

Syriza party says Germany owes Greece nearly 279billion euros, or £204billion .
More than 40,000 people are believed to have starved to death in Athens alone .
German government says issue was resolved legally years ago .
Revised figures amount to nearly 10 per cent of Germany's GDP .

Scott Kemery, 44, was rushed by helicopter to Stony Brook University Hospital on Long Island with first and second degree burns .
Police said that Kemery started the blaze with his ill-timed cigarette break in the parking lot of the King Kullen supermarket in Eastport .
Two other cars were heavily damaged from the flames of the fire .

Murderer Robert Donovan, 57, walked out of Ford Open Prison in Arundel, Sussex, in 2010 .
His disappearance only emerged last year, four years after he had walked out .
Derek Passmore, who beat to death a disabled man in 1996, is still at large .
Ministry of Justice has revealed the names of 29 missing since 2004 and outline details of a further ten .

Aidan Fraley, 16, says his father's killer should never have been deputized and given a gun .
He believes everyone on the Tulsa force is to blame for his father the April 2 death of his father Eric Harris .
Bates, 73, mistakenly thought he was holding a Taser, not his handgun, when he fatally shot the unarmed man .

University of Wisconsin Badgers beat Kentucky Wildcats 71-64 in semi-final Saturday night .
Wisconsin will now face Duke in Monday's NCAA final in Indianapolis .
More than 1,000 angry Kentucky fans set fires and smashed bottles on State Street in Lexington, Kentucky .
Police in riot gear arrested 31 people on charges of public intoxication and disorderly conduct .
Another three people taken to hospital for non-serious injuries .

Ex-Bolton Wanderers striker Delroy Facey accused of being involved in match-fixing plot .
Court hears he 'cast his net around' for players willing to take part in plot to fix lower league matches .
Plaintiff Moses Swaibu, a former semi-professional player, also denies the charges .
The pair are standing trial at Birmingham Crown Court alongside Chann Sankaran and Krishna Ganeshan .

Lord Janner of Braunstone has repeatedly denied claims he abused young boys at care homes .
Allegations surfaced 25 years ago at trial of Frank Beck, a care-home warden .
Beck, a former Liberal councillor, was given five life sentences for abusing scores of children .
Janner has not been seen outside his flat in Hampstead, north-west London, since 2013 .

Trade was taking place between East Asia and the New World hundreds of years before Christopher Columbus arrived in the area in 1492 .
Discovery was made after archaeologists found bronze and leather buckle and a bronze whistle .
Researchers believe the artefacts were created in China, Korea or Yakutia .
The latest discovery of bronze artefacts backs up earlier evidence for trade between Alaska and other civilisations .

New book contains photos of desperate people trying to escape the Stasi's clutches .
People were forced to re-enact their ordeal for the cameras of the secret police .
The pictures were used as evidence in the show trials against those they caught .
They were also thought to have been used for training purposes for border guards .

Dr Sameer Patel reveals hidden ingredients that may be wreaking havoc with your teeth .
Some breakfast cereals contain as many as three teaspoons of sugar per serving .
White bread can contribute to dental decay, because it contains simple sugars that dissolve quickly .
Caffeine is a diuretic and therefore dries out the mouth, counteracting the internal rinsing that normally occurs and causing bacteria to multiply .

Yvonne Camargo, 39, of Victorville, California, was arrested on suspicion of willful cruelty to a child on April 3 .
The video was filmed April 1 in a parking lot after a man identifying as Edward Moneyhanz on Youtube saw the woman 'pulling this kid by his hair out of the khols store'
In the YouTube video Camargo can be seen wiping the young boy's face as he cries .

David Cameron will claim Labour's economic policies could put a million people out of work .
PM will hail the 'jobs miracle' that has seen 1,000 new jobs created every day .
He will vow to encourage more job creation by extending national insurance breaks .
Cameron will launch a Conservative 'jobs manifesto' setting out plans to bring about 'full employment'

Fireman Stephen Hunt, 38, died tackling the fire which began at Paul's Hair World in Manchester .
Girl, 16, charged with arson after she discarded a cigarette causing blaze in July 2013 .
She was originally charged with being reckless as to whether life was endangered .
After more than a year of legal wrangling, fire could not have been started accidentally .

Footage of a large crocodile swimming through a public marina with a dead dog in its jaws has been viewed more than half a million times online .
The clip shows a large croc calmly moving through the marina in the tourist hotspot of Puerto Vallarta, in Mexico .
New Zealander Tim Weston was on holiday with his wife when he saw the alarming sight .

Box truck collided with a car on Interstate 93 southbound in Boston's Dorchester neighborhood .
Both drivers were taken to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries .
Replacement shuttle buses were run for southbound passengers with long queues forming .
The truck driver was identified as a 57-year-old Woburn man and the car driver was 42 .
No charges have been filed and state troopers are investigating the incident .

Court documents reveal that Hamm allegedly set fire to one pledge's pants and beat him with a claw hammer .
Actor, 44, was eventually charged with assault in connection with the November 1990 hazing scandal .
Hamm, who won a Golden Globe for playing Don Draper in Mad Men, got charges dismissed .
The fraternity, Sigma Nu, was shut down for a time after the alleged incident .

Unnamed health worker has returned from West Africa with symptoms which could be Ebola .
The unnamed woman has been placed in an isolation ward at Canberra Hospital for treatment .
Health officials say it's most unlikely she has Ebola and her symptoms are consistent with many other conditions .
She's being treated in complete isolation in a single room under the hospital's Ebola protocol .

The case involves a man from central Queensland who has been charged with torture .
On Saturday a 29-year-old man was admitted to Bundaberg Hospital suffering from fractures, head injuries and burns .
Initial police inquiries were to do with the theft of the man’s car .
After observing his injuries at the hospital police started their own investigation .

Naomi Jacobs was 32 when she was struck with Transient Global Amnesia in 2008 .
She thought it was 1992, John Major was prime minister and she was about to sit her GCSEs .
The condition caused the 'episodic' part of her memory to shut down, meaning she had lost all emotional memories .
After eight weeks her memory began to return to normal and she is now writing a new book .

Mancunian Neil Killham has made the infamous shepherds pie-trifle combination immortalised on Friends .
It features custard, jam, lamb, peas, onions, whipped cream and is garnished with sprinkles .
The dish was made by mistake by Rachel Green (played by Jennifer Aniston) on the show .
She mistakenly used beef instead of the lamb which is traditional in the pie .

BMW Mini has produced concept smart specs to give drivers super-human powers in the car .
The goggles can project navigation information with arrows onto the roads, as well as show speed limits .
An icon is shown on the smartphone-linked display when the wearer receives a text message .
‘Augmented Parking’ feature projects images obtained from a camera on the far side mirror to the glasses .

Sandra Malcolm, 74, found hacked to death at her home in Cape Town, South Africa .
Her grandson reportedly climbed through a window when nobody answered the door .
Reports in South Africa suggest the 74-year-old's attackers had mutilated her .
The murder comes amid a wave of anti-immigrant violence in the country .

Robert Butler, 43, was transported inside a shipping container from Bannister House in Providence, Rhode Island to the Eleanor Slater Hospital in Cranston .
The operation took almost seven hours on Sunday and involved the Providence and Cranston fire departments, Lifespan, the Hospital Association of Rhode Island and Bay Crane Northeast .
Mr Butler weighs around 1,200lb after a decade of battling his weight .

Rolly Robinson, from Beauty High, stars in theunique makeover clip .
Beauty blogger first had to shave his mustache .
He uses an impressive array of cosmetics to help him copy the appearance of the reality star .
After applying makeup and using the lip suction cup for fifteen minutes, Rolly does a pretty good impression of Kylie .

Scott Keyes, 28-year-old writer for Think Progress, is about to travel 20,000miles on 21 flights .
Keyes reveals his travel hacks in his eBooks How To Fly For Free and How To Find Cheap Flights .
He says credit cards are the best way to rack up frequent flyer miles .
Fly on the cheapest days of the week .

LaTasha Gosling, 27, and her three children were found murdered in their home .
The suspect in the case was found hours later dead, and while police would not say how he died they did say that it was not a homicide .
Police have yet to release much information at this time, only saying that the suspect and victim did know one another .

Jon Krakauer interviewed five alleged victims of sexual assault at the University of Montana at Missoula .
Kelsey Belnap said she was gang-raped by four football players, but they were never charged .
Allison Huguet said she had been drinking and was in no condition to drive the night she was allegedly raped .
Hillary McLaughlin claimed she was raped by the same football player who allegedly attacked her friend at a party in 2010 .
Huguet's attacker, Beau Donaldson, pleaded guilty to rape and was sentenced to 10 years in prison .

Calf in northern India has FIVE mouths - believed to be the most ever seen on a calf .
He is being fed three times a day at the dairy farm where he was born .
Calf has been called Nandi - a nickname for Lord Krishna - by locals .
In India's Hindu culture, cows are revered as a symbol of life .

Mary Doyle Keefe, who posed for Norman Rockwell's Rosie the Riveter poster girl, dies aged 92 .
Iconic painting became a symbol for feminism and economic power for American female workers during the war .
Rockwell used artistic licence to make her arms, hands and shoulders bigger .

Lack of natural daylight is thought to be driving up rates of short-sightedness among the young .
Chinese scientists have reported a 23 per cent reduction in myopia in children who spend an extra 40 minutes a day in the sunshine .
Leading eye surgeon David Allamby warned that an increase in eyesight problems is likely in Britain if children do not regain love of the great outdoors .

Yordano Ventura and White Sox outfielder Adam Eaton sparked the brawl .
Umpires ejected a total of five players from both teams after the fight at Chicago's U.S. Cellular Field .
The whole of both teams ran onto the field for the brawl where there was pushing, shoving and even a few punches .

Linda and George Hunter spent a lifetime paying off their mortgage in their home in Liverpool .
Eight years ago, the street became part of a regeneration scheme and council bought properties .
Couple say they would struggle to sell their home for much more than £1 as other houses in the street are being sold off at that price by the council .
They want council to put its original offer back on the table .

Driver, 17, lost control of her Mitsubishi Lancer on Thursday night .
The car crashed into a wheelie bin before smashing into a solid brick wall .
White trail of skid marks were left on the road by the driver, who apparently received her P-plates on the same day her sedan left the road .

Lincolnshire resort joins St Ives and Windermere in top ten league of towns for holiday property .
Billy Butlin located his first holiday park at Skegness in 1936 and it still attracts 400,000 visitors a year .
Research revealed that 165,000 people in England and Wales have holiday homes .
Cornwall, with its 300 mile coastline, is the nation's holiday home hotspot .

Daniel Messel, 49, of Bloomington, was arrested after a police investigation and he is facing a preliminary charge of murder .
Hannah Wilson, 22, was struck three or four times in the back of the head with an unknown object, coroner said .
Wilson was found fully clothed and there was no sign of sexual assault, police said .

Protein World's billboard campaign features a svelte bikini-clad model asking 'Are you beach body ready?'
